title: Listening
description: Four artists, official listening links, and three small sound studies to play in the browser.
heading: Stay for a track.

sections.heading: Different moods, same shelf.
sections.intro: Four artists from the current rotation, with a suggested starting track for each. There is no ranking here, and plenty of room for the selection to change.

artists.name: Linkin Park
artists.note: For the louder end of the shelf. A starting point for listening to the contrast between a restrained opening and a full chorus.

artists.name: Billie Eilish
artists.note: A different kind of intensity. Try following the vocal layers, then return to the same track with attention on the pulse underneath.

artists.name: Ella Langley
artists.track: you look like you love me
artists.note: A duet with Riley Green. A suggested entry into the country corner of the shelf, where a conversation can become the centre of a song.

artists.name: Olivia Dean
artists.note: For a warmer, slower turn. Start with the official video, then explore a live version to hear what changes when a song shares a room with an audience.

sections.sketchIntro: Three original sound studies generated for this site. These are small listening experiments, not recordings by the artists above or compositions by Will. Press Play: each sketch runs locally in your browser.

sketches.title: Glass steps
sketches.description: Bell-like notes pass from left to right. A small study in the space between sounds.

sketches.title: Slow light
sketches.description: Four soft chords overlap and fade. Listen for a new colour arriving before the old one leaves.

sketches.title: Pocket pulse
sketches.description: A low repeating line, small ticks, and a few higher notes. Rhythm with very little machinery.
